title: Descent with Modification
text: Darwin's concept of descent with modification explains how ancestral structures are inherited and then modified for different purposes. The pentadactyl limb is a classic example.

title: Adaptive Radiation
text: From one ancestral limb design, different lineages evolved limbs specialized for grasping (human), swimming (whale), flying (bat), and running (dog). This diversification from a common ancestor is called adaptive radiation.
